title.en: Video plugin duration and upload compatibility
title.zh: 视频插件时长与上传兼容

summary.en: Automatic duration remains opt-in per installed plugin and model contract; character-workbench media limits remain in force.
summary.zh: 自动时长仍以已安装插件及模型说明允许为前提，角色工作台媒体限制继续有效。

body.en:
Automatic duration (`-1`) is accepted only by an installed plugin that declares the capability and a model contract that permits it. Reservation uses the supported maximum and completion settles reported usage. Positive durations retain their model-specific limits.

Plugin multipart uploads use the body boundary generated for the forwarded request. This does not change the character workbench’s reference rules (2–30-second motion-transfer input, 4–30-second object-swap input and 4–30-whole-second output), media checks, or upload limits, and does not launch or enable a video model.
body.zh:
只有已安装插件声明能力且模型说明允许时，自动时长（`-1`）才会被接受。预扣使用支持的最长时长，完成后结算报告的实际用量；正数时长仍遵循模型各自限制。

插件表单上传采用转发请求实际生成的内容边界。本次不改变角色工作台参考规则（动作迁移输入 2 至 30 秒、对象替换输入 4 至 30 秒、成片 4 至 30 整数秒）、媒体检查或上传上限，也不代表新视频模型启用或上架。
